newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $655 million Sept trade deficit.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $655 million Sept trade deficit.

text.p: Brazil posted a $655 million trade deficit in September, with exports totalling $4.115 billion and imports at $4.77 billion, the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said in a statement.
The ministry said September results brought the year-to-date trade deficit to $1.593 billion versus a deficit of $3.412 billion in the January-September period of 1995.
The ministry said September exports were 1.25 percent lower than the same month a year ago, while imports rose 29.41 percent.

It said that compared with September 1995, primary goods grew 13.57 percent, while intermediate exports were down 3.49 percent largely due to international prices for worked aluminium and intermediate iron and steel goods.
The ministry said that imports grew largely due to purchases of fuels and lubricants, which compared with August increased 50.8 percent.
Imports of capital goods dropped 6.5 percent and of consumer goods 7.7 percent, it added.
